title: Customer Identification & Verification Policy
content: All new customer accounts must complete standard identity verification (KYC Level 1) prior to initiating transactions exceeding $5,000. Accounts with incomplete verification (KYC Level 0) are restricted to single transactions under $2,500 and total aggregate daily transfers under $5,000. Accounts aged less than 30 days are categorized as new accounts and require enhanced monitoring for initial wire transfers exceeding $10,000.

title: Anti-Money Laundering & Transaction Monitoring Policy
content: Any single transaction equal to or exceeding $10,000 USD (or foreign currency equivalent) must trigger an automatic Currency Transaction Report (CTR) filing indicator. Transactions structured in rapid succession (e.g., multiple transactions under $10,000 within 24 hours totaling >$15,000) are flagged as suspicious structuring. Cash deposits exceeding $50,000 require senior compliance officer approval.

title: Transaction Thresholds & Escalation Limits Policy
content: Single outbound wire transfers exceeding $100,000 USD require dual-sign-off authorization and secondary fraud score verification. Transactions exceeding $500,000 USD are immediately held for Executive Committee Compliance Review regardless of customer standing.

title: Sanctioned & High-Risk Jurisdictions Policy
content: Transactions involving OFAC comprehensive sanctions countries (Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Crimea Region) are strictly prohibited and subject to immediate asset block and regulatory reporting. High-risk jurisdictions designated under FATF grey-list (e.g., Myanmar, Yemen, South Sudan) require Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) prior to processing.

title: Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) Governance Policy
content: Any transaction initiated by or benefiting a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) or immediate family member/close associate requires mandatory PEP compliance clearance. Cross-border transfers exceeding $25,000 for PEP accounts must include documented Source of Wealth (SoW) verification.

rules.condition: pep_flag == true AND is_cross_border == true AND amount > 25000 AND sow_verified == false
